title: Flying Saucers International, July 1966, pp. 2-3: Special AFSCA Convention Message
description: Two-page spread of printed newsletter text headed "SPECIAL AFSCA CONVENTION MESSAGE," presented as a message received from a purported space being and discussing the Vietnam war, the "military-industrial complex" and world peace. A masthead box for "Flying Saucers International," Issue No. 24, July 1966, published by the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America, Inc., appears at lower left. There are no photographs or illustrations.
